name: Praetorian Guard
notes: Lucius's personal guard. Elite soldiers answering to the Tribune, not the Legate. Extremely dangerous in numbers.
gm_notes: Tribune Lucius arrived with 6 Praetorians. They follow Lucius's orders exclusively -- not Corvinus, not the chain of command. If Lucius orders them to detain the party, they will attempt it. If Lucius dies: roll Morale DC 15 WIS or they withdraw. Session 1 note from README.md: 'Guard / Praetorian | 1/8 | Session 1 | Tribune + 6 Praetorians -- extremely dangerous.' At CR 1 per soldier + 6 = encounter that will overwhelm a level 3 party in direct combat. Resolution is NOT combat. If the party attacks Lucius directly, the Praetorians respond immediately. Remind players of the numbers.
